answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This works because the originality bar tightens as more low-quality answers appear, raising the per-alias cost of a coordinated fake campaign. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be. Consider a willow as the anchor of the cost.
